# Sirach Chapter 17 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 17 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_017_page_001.jpg

---

**17:1** The LORD created human beings from the earth, and makes them return to it again.

**17:2** He gave them a fixed number of days and a set time, and gave them authority over the things on it.

**17:3** He clothed them with strength like his own, and made them in his own image.

**17:4** He put the fear of them in all living things, and granted them dominion over beasts and birds.

**17:5** He gave them the five faculties of the LORD's making, and as a sixth he allotted to them the mind, and as a seventh, reason, the interpreter of his faculties.

**17:6** He formed for them tongue and eyes; he gave them ears and a heart for thinking.

**17:7** He filled them with knowledge and understanding, and showed them good and evil.

**17:8** He set his eye upon their hearts to show them the majesty of his works.

**17:9** And he gave them to boast in his wondrous works forever.

**17:10** They will praise his holy name, in order to declare the majesty of his works.

**17:11** He set knowledge before them and gave them the law of life as an inheritance.

**17:12** He established with them an eternal covenant, and showed them his ordinances.

**17:13** Their eyes saw his glorious majesty, and their ears heard the glory of his voice.

**17:14** And he said to them, "Beware of all unrighteousness," and he gave each of them commandments concerning his neighbor.

**17:15** Their ways are always before him; they will not be hidden from his sight.

**17:16** For every nation he appointed a ruler, but Israel is the LORD's own portion.

**17:17** All their works are as the sun before him, and his eyes are continually upon their ways.

**17:18** Their covenant is never hidden from him, and their iniquities are before the LORD.

**17:19** A person's almsgiving is before the LORD like a signet ring, and he will keep a person's kindness like the apple of his eye.

**17:20** Afterward he will rise up and repay them, and he will bring their recompense upon their heads.

**17:21** But to the penitent he has granted a return, and he encourages those who are losing hope.

**17:22** Return to the LORD and forsake sins; make your prayer in his presence and lessen your offense.

**17:23** Return to the Most High and turn away from iniquity, and hate intensely what he hates.

**17:24** Who will praise the Most High in Hades, as those who are alive and give thanks do?

**17:25** Praise perishes from the dead as if from nothing; but one who is alive and in good health praises the LORD.

**17:26** How great is the mercy of the LORD, and his forgiveness to those who turn to him!

**17:27** For all things are not possible for human beings, since a human being is not immortal.

**17:28** What is brighter than the sun? Yet it can be eclipsed. So flesh and blood devises evil.

**17:29** He surveys the power of the height of heaven, while all human beings are earth and ashes.

**17:30** He is great in knowledge, the LORD, who sees all things forever, and looks upon all the ways of human beings.

**17:31** He has not allowed anyone to announce his works to another's age; but who can inquire into his wondrous works?

**17:32** The assembly of the Most High will see him, and in the exercise of his power all things will be restrained.
